summary: Baidu, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 27, 2026, providing notice of an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) scheduled for August 26, 2026, along with the EGM circular and proxy materials. The proposed resolutions include granting the board a general unconditional mandate to issue additional Class A ordinary shares or convertible securities during a specified relevant period. This is a routine corporate governance matter under Hong Kong listing rules, not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other strategic event. The agenda appears limited to standard share issuance authorization, with no stated terms, pricing, or unusual structural elements. Shareholders should monitor for any unexpected proposals in the circular, but this filing itself is not a special situation.
